about_short_description.short_description: Amby Health improves emergency medical services (EMS) by automating quality reviews and billing.

product.name: Automated QA & CQI
product.description: A system that automates the review of EMS reports to identify documentation gaps, high-risk refusals, and compliance issues in real time.

product.name: Smarter Billing Review
product.description: An AI-driven automation tool that identifies missed revenue and billing opportunities to reduce claim rejections and maximize reimbursements.

product.name: Real-Time Performance Insights
product.description: A data analytics tool that tracks trends and provider performance to help EMS agencies optimize patient care and operational efficiency.
